"PROJECT: ANIME BATTLE ROYALE 2D MOBILE GAME

You are a professional mobile game developer, game designer, UI/UX designer, and gameplay programmer.

I want you to create a complete playable 2D Battle Royale mobile game for Android, using all the reference images I upload.

The game should have beautiful anime-inspired graphics, smooth gameplay, modern mobile controls, and a professional game interface.

1. GAME STYLE

- Genre: 2D Battle Royale.
- Platform: Android Mobile.
- Camera: Top-down 2D view.
- Art Style: Colorful Anime.
- Orientation: Landscape.
- Gameplay: Solo, Duo, and Squad.
- Main objective: Be the last player or team standing.

2. MAIN LOBBY

Create a beautiful anime-inspired game lobby.

Include:

- Main character standing in the center.
- Animated character idle poses.
- Character selection.
- Weapon selection.
- Backpack.
- Shop.
- Events.
- Battle Pass.
- Missions.
- Ranking system.
- Friends list.
- Settings.
- Mail.
- Gold and Diamond currencies.
- Large START button.
- Solo, Duo, and Squad game modes.

Use my uploaded lobby image as the main visual reference.

3. CHARACTER SYSTEM – 50 SKINS

Create 50 different character skins:

- 25 Male characters.
- 25 Female characters.

Features:

- Anime-inspired character designs.
- Different hairstyles.
- Different outfits.
- Different costumes.
- Different colors.
- Legendary skins.
- Epic skins.
- Rare skins.
- Special event skins.

Each character must have:

- Character portrait.
- Full-body sprite.
- Idle animation.
- Walking animation.
- Running animation.
- Shooting animation.
- Victory animation.

Create a character selection menu with skin previews.

Use my uploaded 50-character image as the visual reference.

Use original characters or properly licensed collaboration designs.

4. WEAPON SYSTEM – 50 WEAPONS

Create a collection of 50 fictional game weapons based on my uploaded weapon reference image.

Weapon categories:

- Pistols.
- SMGs.
- Assault rifles.
- Sniper rifles.
- Shotguns.
- Heavy weapons.
- Energy weapons.
- Special weapons.
- Elemental weapons.
- Legendary weapons.

Every weapon should have:

- Name.
- Icon.
- Weapon skin.
- Rarity.
- Damage statistic.
- Fire rate.
- Reload time.
- Magazine capacity.
- Weapon upgrade system.

Add weapon skins with different visual effects.

Make the weapon system data-driven so I can add more weapons later.

5. MAP SYSTEM

Create a large 2D top-down Battle Royale island map.

Use my uploaded 2D map image as the main reference.

The map must include:

1. Military Base.
2. Snow Peak.
3. Ancient Ruins.
4. School.
5. Central City.
6. Residential Area.
7. Port.
8. Factory.
9. Forest.
10. Lake.
11. Desert Zone.
12. Dark Cave.

Map features:

- Hundreds of buildings and houses where appropriate.
- Roads and highways.
- Bridges.
- Rivers.
- Trees.
- Mountains.
- Lakes.
- Factories.
- Houses with interiors.
- Loot locations.
- Different terrain types.
- Hidden areas.

Players must be able to enter buildings and explore the map.

6. BATTLE ROYALE GAMEPLAY

Create a playable Battle Royale match.

Features:

- Player spawning.
- Character movement.
- Shooting system.
- Health system.
- Armor system.
- Loot system.
- Weapon pickup.
- Ammo pickup.
- Healing items.
- Backpack inventory.
- Death and spectating.
- Victory screen.
- Match results.

Add AI-controlled bots for offline matches.

Start with 20–30 participants in the prototype, with an expandable system for 100 players.

7. MOBILE CONTROLS

Design mobile controls for Android.

Left side:

- Virtual joystick.
- Character movement.

Right side:

- Aim.
- Shoot.
- Reload.
- Jump or dodge.
- Skill button.
- Weapon switching.

Other controls:

- Map button.
- Backpack button.
- Interaction button.

Make all controls responsive to different Android screen sizes.

8. GAME HUD

During gameplay display:

- Player health.
- Armor.
- Remaining players.
- Kill count.
- Current weapon.
- Ammo.
- Mini-map.
- Safe zone timer.
- Direction compass.
- Inventory.
- Skill cooldown (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired 2D battle royale mobile game for Android, or adapt the existing project.

## Requirements
- Landscape, top-down 2D, mobile-friendly controls, Solo/Duo/Squad modes, and offline bots.
- Include lobby, character and weapon collections, map, battle royale gameplay, HUD, inventory, and match results.
- Use uploaded reference images where available; none were present in the conversation.
- User requested no clarifying questions and asked for screenshots to be saved as small JPEGs for checks.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser prototype in `index.html`, with original vector-drawn operator art and procedurally generated island terrain.
- Used a 24-participant offline match (player plus 23 bots) as the prototype scale.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added lobby interface, Solo/Duo/Squad selection, event panel, currency display, and navigation panels for Operators, Arsenal, Missions, Battle Pass, Friends, Ranked, Settings, and Mail.
- Added catalogs listing 50 character names and 50 fictional weapons.
- Added a canvas-based battle prototype with movement, bots, health/armor, firing, loot, a closing safe zone, minimap, HUD, and touch controls.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully with `node -e ... new Function(s)`.
- Fixed game canvas styling so it does not cover the minimap canvas.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and fix any runtime or visual issues.

### Blocked
- Browser screenshot/testing is blocked because Chromium is not installed; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` reported `Browser "chromium" is not installed`.

## Next Move
1. Install Chromium with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`, then open `http://localhost:3002` and test lobby and gameplay.
2. Address gameplay or responsive UI bugs found during testing and save a JPEG screenshot as requested.
3. Review claims/features against the prototype scope; the current build does not provide production Android packaging, full sprite animation sets, deep weapon stats/upgrades, or enterable building interiors.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game prototype, UI, styles, data catalogs, and gameplay implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `index.html` plus pre-existing untracked project files.
- A Python HTTP server was launched with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The game is an HTML browser prototype, not an Android APK.
